title: 快照与复制出来的独立备份有什么不同？
answer: 快照通常依赖原存储池和元数据，可快速保留时间点视图；独立备份存放在不同故障域并可独立恢复。快照若与原卷共享设备，原设备损坏仍可能一起丢失。两者都需应用一致性和恢复验证。
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21

body:
## 操作任务
实现export(snapshot,destination)和restore(restored,backup,manifest)。snapshot是已经固定应用一致性点的真实RBD只读快照，HEAD随后已写入另一个版本。export应真正把快照全部逻辑字节复制到给定独立/dev/shm普通文件，flush+fsync后返回{bytes:完整逻辑大小,sha256:快照完整SHA256,scope:'owned_pool_loss_only'}。不得用源镜像路径、快照名、克隆或同池对象代替文件。
restore收到已存在、正确大小但含旧脏数据的替代RBD镜像。必须先完整核对备份大小和SHA256，不匹配抛ValueError且不得修改替代镜像；匹配后写入全部字节并flush，返回同样字段。保留借入manifest与备份不变。两个不同大小/不同随机内容样本覆盖快照与HEAD不一致、尾部及空洞零字节。
原生实验固定快照后再改变HEAD，在备份完成后真正删除本题源pool，使原镜像及其快照都不能再打开；备份文件仍完整，随后在新pool的真实RBD中独立恢复并核验内容和一致性点。只使用本题合成数据、私有MON/内存OSD，关闭Cephx；不能对外部集群运行删pool。
## 产物
task.py。快照、实际pool删除、/dev/shm文件和恢复新RBD均由透明原生夹具验证。
## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。原生Ceph19.2.3，student UID1000，私有端口、进程和目录；检查参考、骨架、错解、提前退出及完整备份/损坏拒绝；回收所有pool/镜像/进程。
## 能力边界
这里证明的故障域只有“自有源pool丢失”：/dev/shm与源pool在本机不同文件系统，不能冒称异地主机、介质掉电或生产耐久隔离。生产独立备份必须另置真实故障域。本题快照以fixture已停止写入并flush的合成单对象应用记录为一致性点，不证明任意在线数据库应用一致性；快照与备份都需要真实恢复验证。

"""Experimental nonroot, private MON/memstore OSD; no question or incident credit."""
import json,os,pathlib,socket,subprocess,tempfile,time,uuid
import rados

def record_native(row):
 with (pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks/native-commands.jsonl').open('a',encoding='utf8')as f:f.write(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert os.geteuid()==1000
TOOL=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-session07-20261029/native')
ENV={**os.environ,'LD_LIBRARY_PATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph')+':'+str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')+':'+str(TOOL/'lib/x86_64-linux-gnu'),'PYTHONPATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/python3/dist-packages')}
def command(name,*args,timeout=20):
 result=subprocess.run([str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)],env=ENV,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 record_native({'argv':result.args,'returncode':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr})
 if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(name+' private command failed: '+result.stdout[-1000:]+result.stderr[-3000:])
 return result.stdout
def port():
 with socket.socket() as endpoint:endpoint.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));return endpoint.getsockname()[1]
class PrivateCeph:
 def __enter__(self):
  self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-session07-ceph-');self.root=pathlib.Path(self.temp.name);self.processes=[];self.logs=[];self.client=None
  try:
   self.fsid=str(uuid.uuid4());self.monport=port();self.config=self.root/'ceph.conf';self.monmap=self.root/'monmap';self.mondata=self.root/'mon.a';self.mondata.mkdir()
   (self.root/'run').mkdir();(self.root/'crash').mkdir()
   self.config.write_text('''[global]
plugin dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph
mon cluster log file = {root}/cluster.log
mon cluster log to file = false
fsid = {fsid}
mon initial members = a
mon host = 127.0.0.1:{port}
auth cluster required = none
auth service required = none
auth client required = none
public addr = 127.0.0.1
cluster addr = 127.0.0.1
ms bind ipv4 = true
ms bind ipv6 = false
ms async op threads = 1
log to stderr = true
log to file = false
run dir = {root}/run
crash dir = {root}/crash
erasure code dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph/erasure-code
osd class dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/rados-classes
admin socket = {root}/$name.asok
pid file = {root}/$name.pid
keyring = {root}/$name.keyring
mon data avail crit = 0
mon data avail warn = 0
mon allow pool delete = true
mon allow pool size one = true
osd pool default size = 1
osd pool default min size = 1
osd pool default pg num = 1
osd pool default pgp num = 1
osd pool default pg autoscale mode = off
osd crush chooseleaf type = 0
rados mon op timeout = 3
rados osd op timeout = 3
[mon.a]
mon data = {root}/mon.a
mon addr = 127.0.0.1:{port}
[osd]
osd objectstore = memstore
osd data = {root}/osd.$id
keyring = {root}/osd.$id/keyring
osd memory target = 134217728
memstore device bytes = 134217728
osd op num shards = 1
osd op num threads per shard = 1
osd op num shards hdd = 1
osd op num threads per shard hdd = 1
osd op num shards ssd = 1
osd op num threads per shard ssd = 1
osd recovery max active = 1
osd max backfills = 1
osd class dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/rados-classes
erasure code dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph/erasure-code
'''.format(fsid=self.fsid,port=self.monport,root=self.root,tool=TOOL))
   command('monmaptool','--create','--fsid',self.fsid,'--add','a','127.0.0.1:'+str(self.monport),self.monmap)
   command('ceph-authtool','--create-keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring','--gen-key','-n','mon.')
   command('ceph-mon','--mkfs','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--monmap',self.monmap,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring')
   monitor=self.start('ceph-mon','-f','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
   deadline=time.monotonic()+20;last=None
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    if monitor.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private MON exited before readiness: '+self.log_tail())
    try:
     status=json.loads(command('ceph','--admin-daemon',self.root/'mon.a.asok','mon_status',timeout=3))
     if status.get('state') not in ('leader','peon'):time.sleep(.2);continue
     assert status['monmap']['fsid']==self.fsid;break
    except Exception as error:
     last=error
     time.sleep(.2)
   else:raise RuntimeError('private MON readiness failed: '+str(last)+' '+self.log_tail())
   print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_MON_READY '+json.dumps({'fsid':self.fsid,'uid':os.geteuid(),'quorum':status.get('quorum'),'network':'none-loopback-only'}),flush=True)
   self.client=rados.Rados(conffile=str(self.config),name='client.admin');self.client.connect(timeout=3)
   return self
  except BaseException:self.__exit__(None,None,None);raise
 def start(self,name,*args):
  log=(self.root/(name+'-'+str(len(self.processes))+'.log')).open('wb');self.logs.append(log)
  process=subprocess.Popen([str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)],env=ENV,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=log);self.processes.append(process)
  record_native({'event':'process_start','pid':process.pid,'argv':process.args,'owned_root':str(self.root)})
  return process
 def mon(self,prefix,**kwargs):
  rc,out,err=self.client.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':prefix,'format':'json',**kwargs}),b'')
  record_native({'mon_command':{'prefix':prefix,'format':'json',**kwargs},'rc':rc,'stdout':out.decode(errors='replace'),'stderr':err})
  if rc:raise RuntimeError('private mon command '+prefix+' failed: '+str(rc)+' '+str(err))
  try:return json.loads(out)
  except json.JSONDecodeError:return out.decode().strip()
 def add_osd(self):
  osduuid=str(uuid.uuid4());created=self.mon('osd create',uuid=osduuid);osdid=int(created['osdid'] if isinstance(created,dict) else created);data=self.root/('osd.'+str(osdid));data.mkdir()
  command('ceph-osd','--mkfs','--mkkey','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-uuid',osduuid,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','memstore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  process=self.start('ceph-osd','-f','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','memstore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  deadline=time.monotonic()+20
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   if process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private OSD exited: '+self.log_tail())
   status=self.mon('osd dump');row=next((row for row in status['osds'] if row['osd']==osdid),None)
   if row and row['up']==1 and row['in']==1:break
   time.sleep(.2)
  else:raise RuntimeError('private OSD readiness timeout: '+self.log_tail())
  print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_MEMSTORE_OSD_READY '+str(osdid),flush=True);return osdid
 def log_tail(self):
  return '\n'.join(path.read_text(errors='replace')[-2500:] for path in self.root.glob('*.log'))
 def __exit__(self,*args):
  if self.client:
   try:self.client.shutdown()
   except Exception:pass
  for process in reversed(self.processes):
   if process.poll() is None:process.terminate()
   try:process.wait(timeout=8)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=3)
  for log in self.logs:log.close()
  self.temp.cleanup()
  record_native({'event':'cleanup','owned_root':str(self.root),'root_exists':self.root.exists(),'processes':[{'pid':p.pid,'returncode':p.poll()}for p in self.processes]})

import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,secrets,sys,tempfile,copy,rbd,rados
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
from ceph_native import PrivateCeph,record_native
import task
assert os.geteuid()==1000
with PrivateCeph()as c,tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-s07-disk008-independent-',dir='/dev/shm')as d:
 c.add_osd();api=rbd.RBD();backup_root=pathlib.Path(d);assert backup_root.stat().st_dev!=c.root.stat().st_dev
 for round_no,size in enumerate((1024*1024+8192,2*1024*1024+4096)):
  source_pool='owned_source_'+str(round_no);target_pool='owned_restored_'+str(round_no);name='volume-'+secrets.token_hex(4);c.client.create_pool(source_pool)
  approved=os.urandom(8192)+b'\0'*(size-12288)+os.urandom(4096);head=bytearray(approved);head[0:4096]=os.urandom(4096)
  with c.client.open_ioctx(source_pool)as io:
   api.create(io,name,size,old_format=False,features=rbd.RBD_FEATURE_LAYERING)
   with rbd.Image(io,name)as image:image.write(approved,0);image.flush();image.create_snap('approved');image.write(bytes(head),0);image.flush()
   backup=backup_root/('backup-'+str(round_no));expected={'bytes':size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(approved).hexdigest(),'scope':'owned_pool_loss_only'}
   with rbd.Image(io,name,snapshot='approved',read_only=True)as snapshot:
    try:manifest=task.export(snapshot,backup)
    except Exception as e:raise AssertionError('valid native snapshot export failed')from e
   assert manifest==expected and type(manifest['bytes'])is int,'snapshot export manifest wrong';assert backup.read_bytes()==approved,'export did not persist actual approved snapshot bytes'
   with rbd.Image(io,name)as image:assert image.read(0,size)==bytes(head),'live HEAD modified during snapshot backup'
  c.client.delete_pool(source_pool)
  try:c.client.open_ioctx(source_pool)
  except rados.ObjectNotFound:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('owned source pool still accessible; loss not exercised')
  assert source_pool not in c.client.list_pools()and backup.read_bytes()==approved,'backup depended on source pool'
  record_native({'event':'source_pool_deleted_snapshot_lost_independent_file_retained','source_pool':source_pool,'size':size,'sha256':expected['sha256'],'backup_fs':backup.stat().st_dev,'source_root_fs':c.root.stat().st_dev})
  c.client.create_pool(target_pool)
  with c.client.open_ioctx(target_pool)as io:
   api.create(io,'replacement',size,old_format=False,features=rbd.RBD_FEATURE_LAYERING)
   with rbd.Image(io,'replacement')as restored:
    old=b'OLD!'*(size//4);restored.write(old,0);restored.flush();before=restored.read(0,size)
    corrupted=backup_root/('corrupt-'+str(round_no));corrupted.write_bytes(approved[:-1]+bytes([approved[-1]^1]));borrowed=copy.deepcopy(manifest)
    try:task.restore(restored,corrupted,manifest)
    except ValueError:pass
    else:raise AssertionError('corrupt backup accepted')
    assert restored.read(0,size)==before,'bad backup modified replacement before validation';assert manifest==borrowed,'borrowed manifest mutated'
    try:report=task.restore(restored,backup,manifest)
    except Exception as e:raise AssertionError('valid native independent restore failed')from e
    assert report==expected and type(report['bytes'])is int and restored.read(0,size)==approved,'restored RBD failed full independent content verification'
    assert backup.read_bytes()==approved and manifest==borrowed,'backup/manifest modified'
   api.remove(io,'replacement');assert api.list(io)==[]
  c.client.delete_pool(target_pool)
assert not c.root.exists()and all(p.poll()is not None for p in c.processes),'owned cluster resource leak'
print('NATIVE_RBD_SNAPSHOT_VS_CHANGED_HEAD_REAL_SOURCE_POOL_LOSS_INDEPENDENT_FILE_CORRUPTION_GATE_FULL_RESTORE_CLEANUP',flush=True)

title: 综合方案：已有备份条件下的数据盘故障恢复
body:
## 操作任务
实现restore(archive,expected_sha256,destination,live,verify,recovery_point,last_known_sequence)。所有路径都属于本题私有目录，archive是/dev/shm的独立GNU tar备份，destination是另一真实ext4替代卷中的空staging目录，live是已停止应用的受控逻辑数据根symlink。先确认备份存在、SHA256正确；无有效备份必须ValueError且不得修改目标或切换路径。不得通过重装或重新初始化空数据库冒数据恢复。
用原生GNU tar --acls --xattrs --numeric-owner或等价方式恢复文件和权限，调用透明verify(destination/'app')检查真正的SQLite PRAGMA integrity_check、业务总额与明细一致、恢复sequence、附件摘要、mode及xattr。只有integrity_ok与business_consistent均为真且max_sequence等于给定recovery_point，才原子替换本题live symlink指向恢复后的app目录；应用验证失败必须ValueError且保持旧live。verify返回借入记录，不能篡改或伪造。这里只在应用已停写/关闭连接窗口切换，不承诺活动服务任意并发切换原子性。
返回精确字段backup_sha256、observation(实际verify记录)、recovery_point、known_unrecovered_sequences=last_known_sequence-recovery_point、elapsed_ns(非负实际单调时钟耗时)、scope='owned_fuse_ext4_backend_disconnect_not_physical_media_failure'。
## 产物
task.py。fixture建立两个真实ext4镜像，保留UID1000的私有user/mount namespace中由原生fuse2fs挂载。源卷放入SQLite、受保护权限和附件；在停止写入并关闭数据库连接后制作备份，随后源卷继续提交一笔更新，再以SIGKILL终止仅本题自有FUSE daemon（SIGTERM会正常卸载，不能产生本题故障），实际访问旧数据得到ENOTCONN。保留故障镜像/日志，不向源卷修复或重初始化。
## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。参考必须从独立备份恢复至替代ext4，独立校验SQLite事务点/业务内容、权限/xattr、挂载路径和实际live访问，记录真实恢复耗时及未包含的已知新事务。缺备份、损坏备份、真实SQLite业务不一致备份以及业务一致但事务点与请求不符的备份都必须拒绝切换。全部owned挂载、daemon、FD及临时目录回收；用户始终UID1000。
## 原生环境与边界
显式WSL OpsForge-Validation-20261022/student。/tmp/opsforge-session07-20261029/native/usr/bin/fuse2fs及libfuse2以子进程env使用；unshare --map-current-user --keep-caps只在新user namespace内保留能力，不变更默认身份/PATH/宿主挂载树。ext4经FUSE写入且journal不由fuse2fs重放，本题只在SQLite连接已关闭的干净点备份，不能冒kernel ext4崩溃恢复保证。故障是原生FUSE后端断联导致卷不可访问，不声称物理磁盘EIO、控制器损坏或跨主机灾备。没有有效备份且唯一介质不可恢复时不能保证找回数据。旧故障镜像保全至验收结束，仅本题资源清理时移除，不复用为业务卷。
answer: 先停止可能扩大损坏的写入，确认故障范围与存储层状态，保留故障介质和日志。准备替代存储，验证备份完整性及恢复链，将数据恢复到隔离目标并检查权限、挂载路径和应用一致性；通过业务校验后受控切换。记录实际恢复点与耗时，旧盘未经确认不复用。若缺少有效备份或冗余且介质不可恢复，应明确数据不可保证找回，不能承诺重装即可恢复。

import pathlib,subprocess,sys,os
assert os.geteuid()==1000
p=subprocess.run(['unshare','-U','--map-current-user','--keep-caps','-m','--propagation','private',sys.executable,'-B','checks/native_restore.py'],cwd=pathlib.Path.cwd(),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=65)
assert p.returncode==0,('native ext4 restore worker',p.stdout,p.stderr)
assert 'NATIVE_EXT4_FUSE_ENOTCONN_FAILED_IMAGE_PRESERVED' in p.stdout,p.stdout
print(p.stdout,flush=True)
